# Hikari-Tasks
A full-stack productivity app.

## User Features

* Register / login (JWT + refresh tokens)
* Create boards → lists → tasks (like Trello)
* Drag-and-drop tasks
* File uploads
* Activity log
* Dark mode
* Technical Features
* Backend: FastAPI + PostgreSQL + SQLAlchemy
* Auth: JWT auth + refresh cookies
* Queues: Celery + Redis (for async notifications)
* Docs: Swagger/OpenAPI auto generated
* Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind + TanStack Query
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions
* Deploy: Docker + Railway (or AWS later)
* Tests: pytest, Jest
